t: Full article: EndoC-βH1 cells display increased sensitivity to sodium palmitate when cultured in DMEM/F12 medium
s: The recently generated human β-cell line EndoC-βH1 are transformed human β-cells that contain one order in magnitude less insulin than primary human β-cells, but respond to both glucose and GLP-1 with an increased insulin release.1 Moreover, recent studies have reported that the glucose-induced respiration and stimulus-secretion coupling responses of EndoC-βH1 cells resemble those of human islets.2,3 Thus, the EndoC-βH1 cells share important characteristics with primary human β-cells, which has facilitated several in vitro studies aiming at understanding β-cell physiology and pathological responses.
